thun bar gtor 'bul grub gnyis 'dod 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī ye/thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa mdor

tei:div.tei:p: )thun bar gtor 'bul grub gnyis 'dod 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī ye/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus bya ba la/ rlung me thod sgyed gsum gyi steng*/ bde skyong bhandha rab yangs par// gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// kha chod sbyong byed tshogs bcas gsal// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas cho 'phrul gyis// ma dag dri ma'i tshogs kun sbyangs// 'dod dgu mchod pa'i sprin 'phro ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang thugs las 'phros 'od zer gyis/ mchod yul ma lus spyan drangs nas/ rdo rje'i dbyibs sogs ye shes ljags/ brkyangs bas mchod rdzas rol par gyur/ rtsa sngags mthar/ e daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis 'bul/ hūm̐/ thog ma'i ston pa 'od mtha' yas// 'chi med padma saṃ bha wa// dbang chen rta mchog he ru ka /gsang ye gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// tshe lha mgyogs ma sgo ma sogs// rta mchog dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor lha// bka' sdod pho nyar bcas pa la// dam rdzas dpal gyi ba liṃ ta// phyi nang gsang mchod mtha' klas pa// mkha' dbyings khyab par spros te 'bul// gsang gsum dag pa'i yon tan la// mi phyed gus pa'i yid kyis bstod// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dhya na'i mtshan nas rten bcas bskul ngor/ rmongs ban blo gros smra ba'i dbang phyug tu 'bod pas rtsa gsum lha la gsol ba btab ste mgyogs bris su spel ba nongs pa'i tshogs rnams bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/// /
